title: UG-054 — Quick start path to create and publish a first survey
intent: Provide a compact end-to-end orientation without duplicating detailed topic articles.
short_answer: The basic path is: connect to EUSurvey, create a new survey, add and edit form elements, test the questionnaire, and publish it from the Overview page. Use the detailed KB articles for each step.
important_conditions: This article is intentionally high-level to avoid duplicating detailed login, creation, editor and publishing articles.
For external users, two-factor authentication may apply depending on the login route.
